items.title: Drop-in CI
items.blurb: A GitHub Action, cargo-binstall metadata, and aarch64 Linux and musl builds.

items.title: Drift you can read
items.blurb: check names what changed (a relation added, a module removed) and speaks JSON with --format json.

items.title: Relation kinds you can see
items.blurb: A line and arrowhead per kind, so implements and uses differ at a glance, and a legend.

items.title: Architecture rules and metrics
items.blurb: Rules you declare (no cycles, which layers may depend on which) checked like drift, and coupling metrics per crate and module on their pages.

items.title: A second language: Python
items.blurb: A Python front-end, dogfooded on a FastAPI code base: packages to containers, modules to components, imports to relations.

items.title: Dependencies as externals
items.blurb: Opt-in externals from Cargo.toml, and crate-to-crate summaries on each container page.

items.title: Features and cfg
items.blurb: Know which modules and relations a feature or platform turns on.

items.title: LikeC4's interactive viewer
items.blurb: An option to embed LikeC4's own web component: element details, a relationship browser, search.

items.title: A deployment front-end
items.blurb: Infrastructure as the model's deployment section, which is empty today.
